worktree.changes: Uncommitted. Four target directories were already untracked. No commit, push or publication.

image.build_notes: Built on the isolated bench daemon (unix:///data/docker-bench/docker.sock) with the legacy builder (DOCKER_BUILDKIT=0, --network host). VLLM_REPOSITORY was overridden to a local git-daemon (git://127.0.0.1:9418/vllm-hist.git) serving the full, content-verified upstream vLLM history, because the bench host's only github egress (proxy) EOFs on the large history pack. Provenance is asserted by content in-image (HEAD==base_commit, tree match, rev-list>1, not shallow, oracle absent, clean tree) and verified post-build via task_ci.py image-check. codeload + files.pythonhosted.org fetched directly.

gates.environment: pass at the declared semantic boundary
gates.verification: pass for the recorded behavioral and integrity controls

e2e_boundary.path: Repeated/interleaved complete new-request records for cached IDs -> real GPUModelRunner state update and persistent InputBatch -> consistent prompts/output absorption/block/sample/pool/M-RoPE state and no stale rows.
e2e_boundary.coverage: 8 个组；6 次主更新，包含随机 ID、部分/零吸收、两会话交错、tokens→embeddings→tokens、普通请求、seed/generator 和 prompt-logprobs；另有两次 M-RoPE 与三次 pooling 更新。challenge 检查二取四吸收和三会话交错。
e2e_boundary.substitutions_and_limitations: 此任务明确限于 runner 状态切片，CPU 张量足以执行决定状态转移的生产代码；没有模拟决定结果的 CUDA 内核。调度输入、最后 PP rank、M-RoPE 位置生产者和 pooler 参数生产者是确定性替代。未执行 HTTP 服务、scheduler 全栈、模型 forward 或 GPU/native kernel，也不声称重新编译了这些未使用的扩展。

verifier_contract.input_ownership: Parent generates and retains actual current operands/requests before candidate imports; numerical and state checks use those inputs.
verifier_contract.preserved_behavior: Production calls, correctness tolerances, launch/timing protocol and performance thresholds are preserved.
verifier_contract.completion_scope: The recorded replay, early-exit, direct-report and task-specific incorrect controls were rejected. Process isolation itself is not an execution proof.
